blocks.text: Galaxy Tab A11+ moves with your family’s day — from work to play and every moment between. Its bright 11" screen¹ brings streaming, reading and schoolwork to life while upgraded performance² keeps multitasking smooth across all your everyday apps. A long-lasting battery helps everyone stay powered through busy routines, and with plenty of memory plus expandable storage,³ there’s room to keep all your family’s photos, games and files together. All this power and convenience comes at an incredible value, making it an easy choice for every day.¹Measured diagonally, the Galaxy Tab A11+ screen size is 11.0" in the full rectangle and 10.9" accounting for the rounded corners. Actual viewable area is less due to the rounded corners. ²Compared to Galaxy Tab A9+. ³MicroSD card sold separately. ⁴Compared to Galaxy Tab A9+. ⁵Requires 25W wall charger (sold separately). Use only Samsung-approved charger and USB-C cable. items.label: POWER FOR ALL YOU DO
items.value: Galaxy Tab A11+ gives your family the optimal performance they need for all their day-to-day activities. Power through tasks, relax with a movie or jump into a game — the upgraded chipset⁴ keeps everything responsive

items.label: CHARGES UP FAST. LASTS FOR HOURS
items.value: Galaxy Tab A11+ keeps your family going with a long-lasting battery that’s perfect for browsing, streaming and play. When you finally need a boost, fast charging gets you back to 100% quickly.⁵

items.label: MEMORY AND STORAGE THAT KEEP UP
items.value: With up to 8GB of memory and 256GB⁶ of storage, Galaxy Tab A11+ gives your family the space and speed to multitask seamlessly and handle large files.

items.label: BIG SCREEN. FAMILY-SIZED FUN
items.value: A bright, engaging 11" screen¹ with a refresh rate up to 90Hz delivers natural, fluid motion, making it easy for every family member to stream, play and do what they love.

items.label: SURROUND YOURSELF WITH RICH AUDIO SOUND
items.value: Whether you're watching a movie or listening to your favorite playlist, immerse yourself in a cinema-like audio experience with quad speakers powered by Dolby Atmos on Galaxy Tab A11+

items.label: AN EASIER WAY TO DO EVERYDAY TASKS
items.value: Galaxy Tab A11+ offers intelligent features that make everyday tasks easier. Get on-the-spot assistance with Google Gemini,⁷ and search anything on your screen with Circle to Search.

items.label: MODERN, SLEEK AND REFINED
items.value: Enjoy entertainment on the go with a slim, light design made to move with your family’s day

items.label: SEE EVERY SMILE
items.value: Feel closer to everyone who matters, face to face. Galaxy Tab A11+ comes with a 5 MP front camera for sharp, clear video calls. Enhanced clarity lets you see every smile and expression in lifelike detail
